protocol: Official TAS test.py path on the full RefCOCO val split (3,811 refs / 10,834 expressions): SAM ViT-H automatic masks, BLIP-2 OPT-2.7B captions, CLIP ViT-B/32 scoring plus spaCy/heuristic spatial rectification. mIoU = mean per-expression IoU; oIoU = pooled intersection/union; Pr@k as logged.
env: conda tas: Python 3.10, torch 2.2.1+cu121, transformers 4.35.2, BLIP-2 OPT-2.7B (HF safetensors), SAM ViT-H, CLIP ViT-B/32, spaCy 3.7 + en_core_web_trf, NLTK wordnet/punkt/averaged_perceptron_tagger; GPU1
notes: Full official RefCOCO val execution. Captions were generated by us with BLIP-2 (the repo does not ship the per-sentence caption file); local fixes: HF Blip2Processor with use_fast=False because the released tokenizer.json is not accepted by the fast tokenizer, and an empty non-synonym noun-chunk guard so the negative-text term is dropped instead of launching a zero-batch CLIP kernel on CUDA.
